content: Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse Bab-Jehová-Ulu selenonikid
Agine, Rey-Salomón Jerusalén-neggweburgi, e-asabin dagmalaga wemarse gochad:
Rey-Salomón we-dummaganse gochad, adi, Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu, David-neggwebur-Sión-nugadgi-siidi, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse sedamalagar.
A-ulale, nii-walagugled-Etanimʼye-nugad-nagunonigu (7), itoakwaa-onoleged-ibagi, bela-Israel-dulemar, Rey-Salomón-asabin gwisgunonimalad.
Israel-dulemar-nuga-nikamalad nonimargu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Bab-Jehová-Ulu onakwismalad.

Geb agi, Bab-Jehová-Ulu sesmalad. David-ega-dordoneg-sobsad sesmarbalid. Aginbali, a-dordonegyaba e-ibmar-ebulemalad-islidikid-bukwad sesmarbalid. We-ibmarmar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad semamai gusad. Levita-dulemar bendaksamarmogad.

Rey-Salomón, degi, bela Israel-dulemar-ese-nonimalad, Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-asabin ambikunonimalad. Agine, amar Bab-Jehováʼga sibad-wawaad ogumakar-uknanai gualid, moli-bebe-nikamalad ogumakar-uknanai guarbalid. Doggus-merguedba geg ebislegusad.
A-sorba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Bab-Jehová-Ulu Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Neg-Ise-Islidikid-siidse sesmalad. Geb baliwitur-dummagan-querubin-e-sakan-urba sismalad.
Baliwitur-dummagan-querubin, Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Neg-Ise-Islidikid-siidgi sakan-aasaa bukwamalad. Deyob Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu, degi, e-suarmar egi yoyoi sigisad.

Bab-Jehová-Ulu-e-suarmar-yoyoid mullusursoggu, Neg-Islidikidgi-gwichir, e-dukumar magasar-dakleged. Magaba-gwichirdi akudakleged. Neg-Islidikidde, Neg-Ise-Islidikid-idu siid. We-garda emi-narmaklenaise deyob amba siid.

Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-yagi, unnila akwa-matargwagwadgi-Bab-Jehová-e-Igar-narmaksad maid. We-akwa-matar, Moisés, Horeb-yar-siidgi-gudigu, mesis gusad. Israel-dulemar-Egipto-yargi-nosmalad-sorba, Bab-Jehová, Horeb-yargine, Israel-dulemarbo igar-mesnai gusad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad Bab-Dummadse-Goled-Neg-Islidikidgi-nodmargua, neg waa-ena sigisad.

Ar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg waa-ena-sigissoggu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi Bab-Dummadga geg bar ibmar-imake gusmalad. Ar ade, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged bela neg-gasa nagusad.
Neg Bab-Dummadga nug-imaklesad
Agine, Salomón sogded:

content.text: Bab-Jehová, degi-inigwele, an bega neg-bur-birigined sobsad.

content: Rey-Salomón, Israel-dulemar-bela-gwigwismaladse aibirided. Geb Israel-dulemargi nued-binsasad.
Geb sogded: “Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummolesun. Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummadid. An-bab-Davidʼga ibmar-imakoye-sogsagusad, sogedba imaksad. Deun, an-bab-Davidʼga weyob sogsa gusad:

‘An Egipto-yargi Israel-dulemar-ononaigusad-akale, dulemar-dadgan-warambe-gakabogwad-danar-bukwad-abargi (12), e-neggwebur-gwensak anga-neg-sobega, an sussulid. Unnila an-Israel-dulemar-iduega, an Davidʼbi sunonikid.’
”An-bab-David, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼga neg-nue-sobbi gusanad.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová an-bab-Davidʼga sogsad: ‘Anga be anse-goled-neg-sobbiedi, nued be binsaenad.
Degi-inigwele, be anga anse-goled-neg sobosulid. Be-machi-nikuoedi, a-dule, anga anse-goled-neg sobnonikoed.’

”Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová ibmar-imakoye-sogsagusad, sogedba imaksad. Ani, Salomón, an-bab-David-sorba an yar-ganonikid. Bab-Jehová-sogsagusadba an Israel-dulemar-e-rey-gangi signonikid. An Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼga an neg-sobnonikid.

A-negyagine, Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Uluga an neg-sobsabalid. A-uluyagi Bab-Jehová anmar-dadgan-ebogwa Igar-Mesisad sabolemaid. Bab-Jehová we-igar-mesis gusad, deunni, anmar-dadgan Egipto-yargi-ononai gusgu.”
Salomón Bab-Dummadse-gochad
Agi, Salomón, Israel-dulemar-onmakbukwad-wagab, Bab-Jehová-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-e-aila-asabin gwisgusad. Geb Salomón, e-argan-niba-onakdegu,

sogded: “Bab-Jehováʼye, be Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad gued. Nibneggi, napneggi Bab-Dummad-baid beyobid sulid. ”Dule-be-nug-odummodimaladga be-igar-mesisad be imaked. Be-nug-odummodimalad, be-sogedba-gudimalad, be nue-sabed.
”An-bab-David-be-nug-odummodigusadga, be ibmar-imakoye-sogsad, be imaksad. ”Emi-iba, ega be ibmar-sogsagusad be-ganguedba be imaksad.

”Emisgi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, an-bab-Davidʼga be ibmar-sogsabalid be imakbali. ”Deun, ega be sognaigusgu: ‘Be-wagan, an-asabin, be-gudigusadyob nued damalale, anba ibsamalale, an-asabin, be-wagan rey-gangi-siged Israel-dulemar-e-idumalaga surguosulid.’
Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, degisoggu, an-bab-David-be-maiga be ibmar-imakoye-sogsa-gusad, emisgi be imake.

”Degi-inigwele, we-napneggi be megegala, ¿sunna we-napnegde bega unniguosi? Ar nibneg-naidbela, billimar-nibneg-nanaidbela, unnisulid. Degite, be-nug-odummoleged-neg an-bega-sobsad-bursunna, ¿sunna unniguosi?
Degi-inigwele, an-ibmar-sognaid be itoge, an bese ibmar-egisnaid be itobali. An-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye an bese-gornaid be itoge.
”Bese-goled-neg-soblesadgi be nakuledii guoed. Aginbali, be sogsagusbalid: ‘An we-neggi gudii guoye.’ Degisoggu, we-neggi an bega sunmakder, be an-itogoed.
We-neggi an bese gollalile, be an-itogoed. Israel-dulemar bese gollarmogale, nibneggi-mai be itogoed. Be anmarga anmar-isgued obeloge.
”Dule-gwensak e-gwenadgi yolesdibe, we-dulega soglesdibe, bese-goled-neg-dummadse nonikoye, agi Bab-Dummad-e-aila-asabin ise-sogar-sogdibe, an egi yolessurye,

nibneg-akale be itogoed, be-sogedba be igar nudakoed. Be-dulamarga be igar nudako. Dule-yoledimalad na e-ibmar-imaksadba be sabsur-odurdakoed, e-ibmar-imaksadba ega be igar nabogoed. Dulemar-akar-ibmar-imaksasurmaladgardina, ega be igar nudakoed, e-ibmar-nued-imaksadba egi be sogoed, gwen be ibmar oakalossurye.

content.text: degi, bega na e-isgusad barsognanai guarmalale,
Geb gannar Israel-dulemar yar-e-dadganga-uklesadse be senonikoed.
Be-igarba nabir nanamalaga, igar-nuedgi be odurdakoed.
Geb be-dulamarga, yar-ega-be-uksadgi, be dii gannar owibaloed.
ade, bebi unnila dule-e-binsaed magar be daked.

content: ”Israel-dulemarsulid, be-dulamarsulid, be-nug-dummarba-maid-itosadba dikasur-danimaladi, deyob be imakmogoed.

content.text: aginbali, an bega bese-goled-neg-sobsadsik-atakbukwa bese gotemalale,
”Geb a-yargi Israel-dulemar gales-bukwadgi na e-isgusad magar itononimalale,

content: ”Degisoggu, an-bese-gornaid nue be itoge, be-dulamar bese-gornamogad nue be itobali. Bese gorleged-iliba bela be itogoed.
Be-dulamar begadga-imakega be bachikii dulemar-bamaladgi obacha gusad. ”Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bur-Dummadye, anmar-dadgan Egipto-yargi be ononaigusgua, deyob be be-mai-Moisésʼga sogsa gusad.”

Salomón, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-asabin Bab-Jehováʼse ise-gollar-siigu, yokorgi sindigar gorsii gusad. Degi, e-arganmar niba-onakwale sii gusbalid. Geb Babse-goled-bergusgua, gwisgusad.
Salomón gwisgusgua, Israel-dulemarga Bab-Jehováʼse goted. Weyob binnasuli sogded:
“Bab-Jehováʼye, be sogsa gusad: ‘Israel-dulemarga an neg-bogidikid nasikoye.’ Emisgindi, ega be nasiknonikid. Belagwable be-mai-Moisésʼga be anmarga ibmar-imakoye sogsagusad, bela be imaknonikid.
”Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, anmar-dadganba be gudii gusayobi, be anmarba gudii gusana gadin, mer be anmar-obanena gadin.
Bab-Jehováʼye, bebina-nue-itogega be anmar-imake, adi, anmar be-sogedba nanamalagar.

”Bab-Jehováʼye, an bega we-ibmar-binai-gusadi, bitigi egi be bane-bane binsadii gusana gadin. Bane-bane ibmar-abelegedba, be an-bendakdii gusana yeerban, degine, deyob be be-Israel-dulamar-bendakbaligar.
Adi, deyobi dule-ainebarmalad magar be-dakmaloed, bede Bab-Jehová guye, beyobid, bab-dummad-baid surye.
Degisoggu, bela Bab-Jehováʼga na be san-ukmala,

content.text: Igi emi-ibagi bemar igar-maidba nanadimala, deyob be nanamala.”

content: Bab-Dummadga ese-goled-neg nugsalesad
Agi, Rey-Salomón, bela Israel-dulemarmala, Bab-Jehová-asabin ibmar-ogumakar uknai gusad.
Salomón Bab-Jehováʼga dogdar-nuedye-sogleged-ibmar-ukleged uknai gualid. We-ibmarmar uksad:

content.text: Deyob, Salomón bela Israel-dulemarmala, Bab-Jehováʼga neg-soblesad nug-imaknai gusad.

content: A-ibagine, Rey-Salomón, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-imba-naid, Bab-Jehováʼga nug-imaknai gusad. We-neg-imba, Bab-Jehová-e-neg-asabin naid.

content.text: degi, gwenatigwar-guega ibdurgan-e-gwallu ogumakar uknai gusbalid.

content: Ar ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-esgoro-gordikidgi-sobaled, Bab-Jehová-e-neg-asabin-siid senisoggu, unnisulid. Ar ade, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ichesulid. Deginbali, dogdar-nuedye-sogleged-ibmar-ukleged ichesurbalid.

Deyob, Salomón, bela Israel-dulemarmala Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabin, ibagugle (7) iba-ononai gusad. Degine, Salomón napi-ibagugle (7) iba-obangusbalid. Belagwable ibambe-gakabake (14) iba-ononai gusad. A-ibase, bukidar-dule-ainebarmalad nonigusmalad. Hamatʼye-neg-nugadginmalad, degi, Egipto-diwarginmaladse-bakale, noni gusmalad. Dulemar bukidar ibase noni gusmalad.

Iba-gwinmaknaid-oibosgua, Salomón dulemar-naesognanaidga napi-sognai gualid, degimaloye. Geb a-dulemar, Rey-Salomónʼgi nued binsananai gusmalad. Bela e-neg-e-negse nade gusmalad. Nadmargu, Bab-Jehová Davidʼga-ibmar-nuegan-imaksadba, degine, Israel-dulemarga-ibmar-nuegan-imaksabalidba, weligwar na itonadapi gusmalad.
